summary: Built SigningPortalPage (route /sign/:sessionId) with OtpVerificationModal, SignaturePadModal and DeclineToSignModal, matching the 'Sign Document' target design (IMG-6/7/8): a green signer-status banner, an OTP-gated identity card that locks for 15 minutes after 3 invalid attempts, a document viewer revealed only post-OTP, a Draw/Type/Upload signature pad, and an inline Decline-to-Sign reason prompt. Wired to GET /signing-sessions/{sessionId}, POST .../otp/verify, .../otp/resend, .../sign and .../decline via a new signingSessionService.js and five new hooks. Lint, build and the full Vitest suite (76 tests, including 6 new ones) pass.

code_files.description: Typed client for the /api/v1/signing-sessions/{sessionId} resource group: get session, verify/resend OTP, apply signature, decline.
Fetches the current signer's session state (loading/error/refetch).
Requests a new signing link/OTP after lockout or expiry.
Applies the signer's signature via the Signature Pad.
Submits a Decline to Sign action with a mandatory reason.
6-digit OTP entry gating the document viewer/Signature Pad; locks 15 minutes after 3 invalid attempts, with a live countdown.
Mandatory Signature Pad with Draw (canvas)/Type/Upload tabs; blocks submit when empty; Sign button.
Decline to Sign control with a mandatory reason field, available only to the active signer.
Signer-facing signing portal page: expired-link, out-of-sequence, declined, signed, and OTP/document/signature states, matching the target design frame.
Screen-level tests: expired link, out-of-sequence block, OTP gating, successful OTP reveal, 3-strike lockout, decline submission.

pr.title: feat(ui-gen): SigningPortalPage — OTP-gated signer portal with signature pad and decline flow
pr.body: Implements SigningPortalPage, OtpVerificationModal, SignaturePadModal and DeclineToSignModal for UC7 (T-SIGNING-PORTAL-PAGE-UI), matching the 'Sign Document' target design. Wires GET/POST /api/v1/signing-sessions/{sessionId}(/otp/verify|/otp/resend|/sign|/decline) through a new signingSessionService.js and five hooks, with loading/empty/error/populated states and no mock data. Lint, build and the full test suite pass.

blockers: No route path is specified in context.json/CLAUDE.md for SigningPortalPage (only the sessionId prop is given). Inferred route '/sign/:sessionId', modeled after the existing external-link pattern ExternalReviewPage uses at /negotiation/external/:linkToken — the only precedent for a secure, signer/external-facing route in this repo.

SigningSessionResponse/VerifyOtpResponse do not declare an attempt counter field beyond 'attemptsRemaining' and 'lockedUntil' (both nullable). The OTP lockout UI (3 invalid attempts -> 15 minute lock) is driven client-side from these two optional response fields plus a local counter fallback, since no dedicated 'attemptCount' DTO field exists — inferred per the task's 'missing field' guidance, never inventing a new field name, only computing state from what the response already declares.

Design IMG-4/5 (Add Signers / Signing Tracker) are in this task's image set but belong to SignerListPage (already implemented in a separate task) — only IMG-6/7/8 ('Sign Document') were used as the target design for this task's components, per the task's own scoping note that other screens' content in the context images is not owned here.

Live browser screenshot verification against the TARGET DESIGN could not be completed in this sandbox: starting a background dev server / local mock backend process requires an interactive approval this autonomous run could not obtain. Visual fidelity was instead verified by close manual comparison of the implemented JSX/Tailwind structure against each of IMG-6, IMG-7 and IMG-8 (banner copy/badges, OTP card copy and hint text, document viewer badge, Draw/Type/Upload tabs and hint text, signer/email/Sign/Decline footer). Lint, typecheck (JS, no-op), build and the full Vitest suite (76 tests) all pass.

SigningSessionResponse has no field distinguishing 'not yet their turn' from a generic blocked state beyond isCurrentTurn + an optional blockedMessage string; the page renders a single 'Waiting on an earlier signer' block for !isCurrentTurn using blockedMessage verbatim when present, falling back to the story's own wording otherwise — no new field was invented.

The repo's dev-only auth headers (X-User-Role/X-User-Id in http.js) are hard-coded to TENANT_ADMIN and cannot represent a SIGNER identity per signing session; consistent with how ExternalReviewPage (an analogous secure-link screen) already omits a role gate, SigningPortalPage performs no client-side role check and relies on the backend's own 401/403 enforcement for the SIGNER-only endpoints it calls.
